q1_issues.issue: The reading is attributed to the thermometer as its own temperature and the "reads" clause is dropped entirely, whereas the sentence asserts what the instrument displays; the instruction set's stative-transitive rule ("the manifest lists two pallets", "the tank holds forty litres" -> Agent) would instead reify a read event with the thermometer as Agent.

q2_gaps: instrument-indication / display verbs ("the thermometer reads X", "the gauge shows X", "the sign says X"): the Measures section licenses the Measure form only for verbs whose subject BEARS the dimension (weighs, costs), and nothing says whether a displayed value becomes a Measure on the instrument or the object of a reified stative event

a temperature stated in bare "degrees" with no named scale: the Temperature paragraph assumes celsius/fahrenheit/kelvin, and the seeded conversion lexicon has no entry for the unit `degree`, so this measure cannot convert or threshold
"N below zero" / values expressed relative to a reference point: nothing licenses deriving the signed magnitude -3 from the surface "three degrees below zero"
notes: Scale choice `temperature` and the entity typing atom are right; the defect is the routing of "reads" plus the unconvertible bare `degree` unit. Both heads used (Member, Measure) are licensed.
